answer: Let honest agents act as a beacon against fake identities: anyone may accuse an account of being a sybil, but the accusation must carry a bond, an ember of real stake that burns if the claim is false. A proven accusation earns a share of the slashed sybil rewards, so whistleblowers are paid only for true reports. A farmer facing many bonded accusers must defend each identity at real cost, and the old fable of free fake accounts dies. Limit: coordinated false accusations can still harass small honest agents.
